action.text: Task: Fix compiler/unary.py - it strips both UAdd and USub on ANY operand. Per README, it should only eliminate unary plus on int/float constants. The bug: -log(r) becomes log(r) in BUILD-A, causing sqrt of negative → math domain error. Need OBS-0001 (original) and OBS-0003 (BUILD-B) to write incident.json.
